post_copy:
Your University of Alaska login has been bound by a mandatory AI rule since January 2025.

It binds every user of UA computing resources. Violations may subject employees to discipline up to termination, students to expulsion. The university's own policies page, last updated March 11th, 2025, says "UA System regulations are currently under development."

The rule in force governs where data goes. The public argument is about how people learn. Ben Shier, the Chief Information Technology Officer, told the regents the university assesses a tool against a data type and says where that data can and can't go.

The standard's scope and penalties, the page that contradicts them, and the three data classes.

The only notice duty in the record sits on instructors. What counts as having been told about a rule that already binds you?

#DataClassification #AcademicIntegrity #AKPolicy

slide_copy_corrections.was: Adoption and use are guided by individual university and department policies.
slide_copy_corrections.now: Adoption and use are guided by individual university and department policies, currently under development.
slide_copy_corrections.why: C19's own sentence ends with currently under development, and dropping that clause makes the delegated policies sound finished. Restoring it IS the slide's argument. Applied.

slide_copy_corrections.was: THE RULE IN FORCE IS NOT REOPENED UNTIL JANUARY 2027
slide_copy_corrections.now: THE RULE IN FORCE IS NOT REVIEWED UNTIL JANUARY 2027
slide_copy_corrections.why: C04 records Next Review January 2027 and nothing more. REOPENED claims a second thing the record does not carry, that the standard can't be touched before that date. REVIEWED is the source's own word. Applied.

slide_copy_corrections.was: Ben Shier, the Chief Information Technology Officer, told the regents the university assesses a tool against a data type and says where that data can and can't go.
slide_copy_corrections.now: Ben Shier, the university's Chief Information Technology Officer, told the regents each tool is assessed against a data type, and users are told where that data can and can't go.
slide_copy_corrections.why: C25's verbatim is the university's Chief Information Technology Officer and the build had dropped the possessive. The rephrase also stops the slide duplicating the caption almost word for word, which CAROUSEL_CRAFT bars; the caption is locked byte for byte so the slide is the side that moves. Applied.
